CAT Women's Ride

Bethlehem, PA · Sand Island · Social · Mixed

CAT Women's Ride is a social group ride in Bethlehem, PA. Schedule: Weekly, Tuesday or Wednesday evening at 6:00 pm; sign up on Meetup for the exact day, from Charlie Brown Ice House, Sand Island. Pace: easy, social. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy, social. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the CAT Women's Ride group ride

An easy women's ride on streets and trails toward Easton or Allentown, from the Ice House on Sand Island. Nobody gets left behind and the group often stops for a drink after. CAT also runs weekend social rides from its co-op on Walnut Street and weekday-morning coffee rides.
